title: Clayton Bailey’s World Of Wonders

services.name: Tobacco Spit Pottery
services.desc: The Tobacco Spit pottery of Clayton Bailey was made between 1987-1998. Tobacco spit glaze originated long ago among American folk potters. When the glaze is fired, it runs down the sides of the pot in golden brown rivulets that earn the glaze its name. Baileys jugs were inspired by traditional salt glazed American pottery. The jugs are beautifully formed, and often outlandish in scale; (some are thirty to fifty gallons in size.) They are labeled as containing Mustache Oil, Unobtainium, Claytonium, or Snake

blurb: Welcome to the official website of Clayton Bailey, a visionary artist whose imaginative ceramics push the boundaries of traditional art. Dive into his world of whimsical robots, fantastical medical curiosities, and playful metal rockets, each piece a testament to his unique blend of science, humor, and creativity.
